query:
SELECT 
  poi.id,
  poi.purchaseOrderId,
  poi.installmentNumber,
  poi.amount,
  poi.paidAmount,
  (poi.amount - COALESCE(poi.paidAmount, 0)) as pending,
  poi.status,
  poi.dueDate,
  po.supplierId,
  p.name as supplier_name
FROM purchaseOrderInstallments poi
LEFT JOIN purchaseOrders po ON po.id = poi.purchaseOrderId
LEFT JOIN partners p ON p.id = po.supplierId
WHERE poi.status = 'PENDENTE' OR (poi.amount - COALESCE(poi.paidAmount, 0)) > 0
ORDER BY pending;
